intent.purpose: photo-post frame: lying on a mat between sets at an outdoor turf area, selfie from above
intent.scene_concept: woman lying back on a workout mat on artificial turf, both arms up holding the phone above her face
intent.place_type: outdoor artificial-turf training area of a gym (not a park lawn, not a beach)
must_stay_true: she is reclined on a gym mat and shooting straight down at herself

appeal.relative_to_inspiration: as attractive as or more attractive than the source posts this scene class came from; the rawness is in the photo, not in her looks
appeal.face: very pretty, glowing after training, bright eyes squinting against the sky
appeal.physique: fit and sporty with toned arms and shoulders

subject.description: one woman resting between sets outdoors
subject.action: taking a front-camera selfie with both arms extended upward
subject.pose: lying on her back, head resting on the mat, arms reaching up toward the camera, ponytail spread under her head
subject.expression: tired, small pout, eyes squinting slightly against the sky
subject.face_visibility: full face, upside-down framing avoided: head at the top of the frame

identity.skin: warm light-medium tan, flushed from training, sweat on the forehead and upper lip, visible pores and a few freckles
identity.hair: light-brown high ponytail with a messy fringe of flyaways stuck to the damp forehead
identity.face: no makeup except a little mascara, believable asymmetry

physique.detail: arms and upper body visible, arms foreshortened toward the lens

items: soft pink long-sleeve cropped training top
white sports bra strap visible at the neckline
lavender over-ear headphones pushed down around the neck
wardrobe.fit_and_condition: top bunched at the shoulders from lying down, sweat patch at the collar

environment.setting: outdoor turf training strip beside a gym, bright afternoon
foreground: her forearms and hands at the edges of the frame
background: charcoal ribbed exercise mat under her head and shoulders
green artificial turf blades around the mat, with a faded painted line
the tip of a kettlebell handle at the frame corner
environment.clutter: minimal: kettlebell, a water bottle lying on the turf

camera.position: directly above her face at arm's length, pointing straight down

composition.subject_placement: face in the upper-middle; arms entering from the bottom corners
composition.crop: hands cut off by the frame edges
composition.headroom: a strip of turf above the head

sources: direct afternoon sun from the upper right
lighting.direction: upper right, raking across the face
lighting.quality: hard with crisp shadows from the arms falling across the mat
lighting.exposure: bright; highlights on the forehead and nose close to clipping

color.saturation: slightly boosted turf green from phone processing
casts: green bounce from the turf on the underside of the jaw

processing.pipeline: stock iPhone camera app, front camera
processing.hdr: Smart HDR lifting the arm shadows

imperfections: arm shadows across part of the face
forearms slightly enlarged by the wide front camera

texture.skin: pores, sweat beads on the upper lip, freckles, fine arm hair
texture.fabric: brushed cotton top with pilling at the cuffs
texture.surfaces: plastic turf blades with rubber crumb between them, ribbed rubber mat

anatomy: exactly two arms, both reaching up to the phone out of frame
wrists and elbows bend correctly for a top-down selfie
the headphones sit around the neck, one pair only
physics: the ponytail spreads on the mat under gravity
arm shadows match the sun direction
geometry.perspective: top-down wide selfie perspective with forearms foreshortened, no fisheye

phone.hold: the phone is the camera and is not visible

brands_and_props.branding_policy: keep natural branding: a small logo on the headphones or bottle is fine; do not invent readable text
brands: small logo on the headphone band

exclusions: no Apple Watch or any smartwatch
no second pair of headphones or earbuds
no glamour lighting or golden-hour glow
no airbrushed skin or beauty filter
